# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is the [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) website for the 2nd edition of British Ecological Society's "Guide to Data Management". A print version of this guide has also been [published as a PDF file on Zenodo](ADD LINK WHEN DONE).
